{{Top|leg}}
'''Yellow repair droids''' were created by the [[Quockran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Quockra-4]]. Of the three levels in their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] society, the [[Color/Legends|yellow]] droids were at the top, giving orders to the other droids. The yellow droids had three [[Limb/Legends|limbs]].
